web-net.title: WEB Net®

meta.title: WEB Net® - Safe and Stable Construction Netting System
meta.description: WEB Net® is a reliable, tensioned 'walk-on' netting system designed for safe work at height, offering superior strength and minimal deflection. Installed by experts.
meta.keywords: Construction Netting Solutions, Maintenance Netting System, Tensioned Netting Solutions

web-net.intro:
WEB Net® is our innovative construction netting system that allows maintenance teams to carry out inspections and light work at height. Made to our own designs, the tensioned netting of WEB Net® provides a stable ‘walk-on’ netting system with excellent tensile strength. This system has been engineered and developed over many years and is constructed to minimize the deflection normally associated with other so-called “tensioned” netting.

As a high-rise construction netting system, typical deployments of WEB Net® would be construction projects, the underside of bridges, pipe racks, conveyor systems and associated high-rise infrastructure. Given its excellent tensile strength, WEB Net® is an extremely stable tensioned netting or ‘walk-on’ system that is suitable for a wide variety of work tasks including surface preparation and coating application, masonry & concrete repairs, pipe-work installation, and inspection.

Operatives who work from the net are attached to a primary twin rope or wire rope safety system. All our projects are meticulously planned and are installed by IRATA-trained specialists to ensure safety and productivity at all times.
web-net.features:
• WEB Net® is made from High Tenacity Polyester which is UV stabilised
  • Knotted to provide a sure footing
  • Flame retardant
  • Each net has a unique ID and tag identifying the specifications
web-net.benefits:
Lower Transport & Storage Costs: WEB Net® is 5-10% of the weight and volume of conventional alternative systems scaffolding. It is easier and more cost-effective to transport. Requires minimum storage space on-site and in the yard

Lower Load Weight: WEB Net® has a significantly lower self-weight, allowing it to be used on structures that do not have a high load capacity


Safer Installation & Dismantling: WEB Net® is installed by rope access methods. Rope access is statistically safer for working at a height

Safe: Working at height techniques utilized to install WEB Net® reduce exposure time to working at height


Low Cost: Efficient installation leads to lower labour costs and lower total access costs. Reduced components and material cost

flowlok-ladder-system.intro:
TsaF’s FlowLok Vertical Height Access System (VHAS) Ladder System provides access to the roof, where there are no pre-fabricated ladders or climbing structures available. It can be attached to various buildings with the use of different fasteners, making it an ideal solution across industries such as Power Transmission, Wind, Telecommunications, Storage Bins and Silos, and more.

In the event of a fall, the trolley immediately locks over the rail, thereby arresting the fall. When not in use, the unidirectional locking system of the trolleys does not allow it to fall freely down the guide rail.

The system includes fall protection ladders, guide rails, and self-guiding fall arresters. The FlowLok VHAS adheres to world-class HSE standards. Ancillary safety devices that are uniquely compatible with the fall protection ladder ensure secure access for the operator. All systems are installed by trained specialists to ensure safety and productivity at the site.

  • Lesser surface area ensures mitigation of wind load
  • Simple, cost-effective, and versatile

PortaDeck is a heavy-duty interconnected composite matting system made of HDPE with a compressive strength of 425 tons/sqm. PortaDeck rig mat is used to form approach roads and platforms for the movement of heavy vehicles and equipment on muddy, marshy waterlogged soils even black cotton, mud with high clay content.

The HDPE mats can be laid on slushy or undulated ground with difficult terrains for creating approach roads to construction job sites. The ground stabilization mats are reusable and require minimal maintenance. The ground matting system can withstand the heavy loads of mobile equipment used at construction sites and are most suitable for making access roads for pipeline projects, transmission lines, substations, construction projects, renewable energy (wind and solar), and maintenance jobs.

Portadeck mats are designed to deliver the best type of traction under the harshest weather conditions with fast and easy installation while enabling clients to stick to their schedules and budgets. These innovations facilitate building India’s infrastructure at a much faster pace at an affordable cost that lasts for years to come.

personal-protective-equipment.intro:
Personal Protective Equipment , or PPE, is equipment worn by personnel to minimize exposure to hazards that can inflict serious workplace injuries and fatalities. PPEs can save lives by protecting workers from occupational mishaps from machines and materials that can cause life-altering damage.

PPE such as gloves, safety glasses, shoes, earplugs or muffs, overalls, helmets or hard hats, harnesses, and body suits safeguards from direct contact with chemical, radiological, physical, electrical, mechanical, or other workplace hazards.

All personal protective equipment is engineered and designed to provide maximum safety. One must wear PPEs according to the environment and as directed to make a difference between being safely covered or dangerously exposed.

We bring you a range of world-class personal protective equipment to cover you from head to toe to enhance safety at your workplace. Which PPEs should you pick? Reach out to us, and our expert will help you choose the right one.

porta-deck.title: PortaDeck

meta.title: HDPE Rig Mats for Heavy Equipment | Ground Protection Mats
meta.description: Shop HDPE composite rig mats for heavy-duty ground protection. Ideal for mud, roads & equipment movement. Rent or buy high-performance mats from experts!

porta-deck.intro:
PortaDeck is a heavy-duty interconnected composite matting system made of HDPE with a compressive strength of 425 tons/sqm. PortaDeck rig mat is used to form approach roads and platforms for the movement of heavy vehicles and equipment on muddy, marshy waterlogged soils even black cotton, mud with high clay content.

The HDPE mats can be laid on slushy or undulated ground with difficult terrains for creating approach roads to construction job sites. The ground stabilization mats are reusable and require minimal maintenance. The ground matting system can withstand the heavy loads of mobile equipment used at construction sites and are most suitable for making access roads for pipeline projects, transmission lines, substations, construction projects, renewable energy (wind and solar), and maintenance jobs.

Portadeck mats are designed to deliver the best type of traction under the harshest weather conditions with fast and easy installation while enabling clients to stick to their schedules and budgets. These innovations facilitate building India’s infrastructure at a much faster pace at an affordable cost that lasts for years to come.
porta-deck.features:
• Overlapping mats for strong and durable roads on muddy and marshy ground
  • Dual traction pattern for slip-free movement in any weather
  • Flexible mats that conform to undulating grounds for a continuous surface
  • Move and reuse mats across multiple sites
  • Foam-filled honeycomb structure for strength and lightweight
  • Weatherproof buoyant mats that can even float on water
  • High tensile connectors for effective load distribution over a large area
  • Cam lock system for easy and dependable lock and unlock action
porta-deck.benefits:
• Reduce project delays
  • Resolve ROW issues better
  • Minimize ground preparation and restoration costs
  • Experienced supervisors are always onsite to train and guide the team on mat use
  • Can use a variety of equipment available at the site to lay, remove, and move mats.
  • Optimize equipment utilization
